name: M'ONDUNIQ HI'FUsion Longevity hydrating and smoothing anti-wrinkle face serum
shortDescription: Concentrated hydrating and anti-aging face serum with the biomimetic peptide Tripeptide-2, NMF and plant oils – in the spirit of the Longevity philosophy. 30 ml.
description:
A modern, concentrated hydrating and anti-aging face serum that, in the spirit of the Longevity philosophy, combines intensive skincare with targeted treatment of the visible signs of aging. Its formula helps deeply hydrate, smooth and refresh the skin while supporting its natural regeneration processes.

At the heart of the highly concentrated active complex is the biomimetic peptide Tripeptide-2, complemented by plant extracts, natural oils and Natural Moisturising Factor (NMF) components. With regular use, the serum helps reduce the visibility of wrinkles, makes the skin surface smoother and silkier, and contributes to a fresher, more well-cared-for appearance.
